name: Wellness Shop at Jacuzzi Burlington
landmark: right off the QEW on the North Service Road
localIntro: Burlington and Oakville homeowners tend to want a hot tub that looks as good as it feels, and our Burlington showroom on the North Service Road has become the place in Halton to shop saunas too: every Clearlight Sanctuary infrared cabin and both Serenity cedar outdoor saunas are set up and heated, next to the widest Jacuzzi selection in the region and a full line of swim spas. Whether you are in Aldershot, Millcroft, the Orchard or out in Milton, this is the showroom to see everything in one visit.
whyVisit: Right off the QEW at Guelph Line with easy access from Oakville, Milton, Waterdown and Aldershot, and plenty of parking for a relaxed visit.
deliveryNote: We deliver and install across Burlington, Oakville, Milton, Waterdown, Halton Hills and Georgetown, and we handle the crane lifts and tight side-yard access that come with Halton infill lots.
